name: The Temple of the Moon
summary: The Temple of the Moon is an introductory quest in Darnassus where Sister Aquinne directs adventurers to seek out Priestess A'moora. The Sisterhood of Elune requires aid for a suffering ancient creature dwelling within the boughs of Teldrassil. It serves as the opening call to a solemn ritual of mercy.

sections.title: A Plea in the Gardens
sections.body: While walking among the waters and shaded groves of the Temple Gardens, travelers meet Sister Aquinne, a devoted servant of Elune. Sensing capable hands, she reaches out on behalf of her order. A venerable forest creature is suffering, and the Sisters cannot attend to the matter alone.

sections.title: Into the Moon Temple
sections.body: Sister Aquinne directs candidates toward the grand Temple of the Moon just to the southeast. There, Priestess A'moora coordinates the rituals and practical duties required to address Teldrassil's troubled wildlife, preparing sympathetic allies to carry out a sorrowful task of mercy.

faq.q: Who starts the quest The Temple of the Moon?
aliases: quest giver temple of the moon
where to get temple of the moon quest
who gives the temple of the moon
faq.answer: Sister Aquinne initiates the quest. She can be found standing outside in the Temple Gardens district of Darnassus.
Priestess A'moora is located inside the grand Temple of the Moon, situated just southeast of the Temple Gardens in Darnassus.

faq.q: What is the creature in need of help?
aliases: what is this quest chain about
faq.answer: The creature in question is Sathrah, a revered spider of Teldrassil whose plight leads into a ritual of mercy overseen by the priesthood.

faq.q: Is this quest mandatory to continue the chain?
aliases: is temple of the moon required
can i skip temple of the moon
faq.answer: No. The Temple of the Moon serves as an optional breadcrumb quest. You can speak directly with Priestess A'moora inside the temple to undertake the ritual tasks without visiting Sister Aquinne first.

faq.q: What quest follows after this one?
aliases: next quest after temple of the moon
temple of the moon follow up
faq.answer: Priestess A'moora offers the quest Tears of the Moon, directing you to end Lady Sathrah's suffering and bring back her silvery spinnerets.

faq.q: Why is the Sisterhood of Elune asking outsiders for help?
aliases: why does the priesthood need help
faq.answer: The corruption lingering within Teldrassil's flora and fauna stretches the Sisterhood thin, compelling priestesses to recruit competent travelers who respect nature and the Goddess.

angles.text: For night elves, answering Sister Aquinne is an extension of their duty to protect the sacred ecosystem of Teldrassil and uphold the guidance of Elune's priesthood.
Priests walking the grounds of Darnassus are naturally drawn to the work of the Sisterhood, assisting fellow servants of the divine in rites of healing and mercy.
Druids hold deep concern for any great creature of the wild in distress, making the call from the Temple Gardens an urgent matter of natural harmony.
